notes: Figures come from TrackAIPAC (Citizens Against AIPAC Corruption). Per the site, they 'reflect federal career totals from all pro-Israel PACs & their large donors': 'Donations' or 'PACs' = direct and earmarked donations from pro-Israel PACs to the candidate; 'IE' = independent expenditures (ad spending etc.) by pro-Israel PACs on the candidate's behalf; 'Israel Lobby Total' (a few entries print just 'Lobby Total') is the headline number stored as amount. Data sourced from the FEC; the congress page dates it 7/5/26. amount null with label 'Track AIPAC Approved!' means the site lists the member as rejecting AIPAC and shows no dollar figure; amount 0 means the site prints $0 (often 'newly elected, evaluating'). No per-member pages exist; every member url is the /congress page. Coverage gap: the fetch tool's text of /congress (and the identical /israel-lobby-tracker and /us-senate pages) is capped at 65,602 characters and cuts off at the start of Washington, so WA, WV, WI and WY (29 members) could not be read; the older /states/washington and /states/wisconsin pages show figures only inside images (not readable), /states/westvirginia lists no members, and /states/wyoming, /house and /senate returned client errors. The 6 non-voting delegates (DC, PR, GU, VI, AS, MP) are not listed by the site. Site quirks recorded as shown: Rick Allen GA-12 marked [D]; Chris Deluzio PACs $330,816 exceeds his total $314,836; Gabe Amo, Kevin Kiley, James Comer, Maggie Hassan components do not sum to the total. The /2028 page carries older, different figures for sitting members (e.g. Cruz $1,617,745, Booker $846,471, Gallego $83,219, Kelly $495,311, Slotkin $491,189, AOC $0); members use the /congress figures. Trump admin page figures are rough text claims (e.g. '>$230 MILLION'), kept in amount_text with amount null unless an exact graphic figure was shown.
